meta.title: Kinetic Tiles — Effects Platform · Theme 04
meta.description: A wall of 1,200 living 3D tiles that ripples, flips, and re-paints itself between slides.

blocks.text: Twelve hundred 3D tiles breathe behind your words — and flip in a ripple every time you move.
An instanced mesh of rounded boxes with real lights — cheap to run, dimensional to look at.

items.title: Instanced
items.text: One InstancedMesh renders the whole wall — the GPU barely notices.

items.title: Ripple flip
items.text: A wavefront expands from center; each tile pops and flips 180° as it passes.

items.title: Palette swap
items.text: Colors change mid-flip — the next scene arrives on the tiles' backs.
A calm breathing field with sparse lit accents — covers.
N raised, lit bands for N parallel ideas.
Rings ripple outward from the center — cycles.
Gold diagonals sweep the wall — finales.

blocks.text: Decks come from HTML or Deck IR today — and from your PowerPoint next.
Slides without a scene are **art-directed automatically** from their content.
Five themes, one contract — {flip the wall}.
